note: Grounds for desks/mt5/research/cell_emitter.py: open-source STRATEGY CODE read as testable rules. Same shape as deep_forest_sources.json (name, region, language, route, kind, weight, why, url). New grounds are added HERE, never hard-coded. Routes: github_repo (tree via api.github.com, raw via raw.githubusercontent.com; seed `paths` are the fallback listing when the API is unreachable), gitee_repo (gitee.com/api/v5 tree + raw), github_code_search (api.github.com/search/code; needs GITHUB_TOKEN on the host), page_code (an HTML page whose <pre>/<code> blocks hold source). `venue: crypto_exchange` marks a ground whose strategies were written for a crypto exchange: its cells map ONLY onto Fusion crypto CFDs, and a strategy whose logic reads funding, perpetuals, liquidations or an exchange order book is dropped and counted. `default_instruments` is a DECLARED mechanism transfer used only when the code names no instrument, and every cell says so (instrument_basis). Seed paths marked verified were fetched with HTTP 200 on 2026-09-30.

policy.copy_policy: concept reimplemented through the desk's own family constructors; code is never copied or executed (static parse only, mt5desk/compiler.py's guarantee)
